problem: Production Release Readback proved exact deploy identity and generic routes but did not execute the pricing lifecycle toggle, plan tab, billing switch and NL→EN language interaction that had repeatedly regressed.
root_cause: The canonical production readback used generic route smoke verification while the pricing/i18n verifier existed only in a separate workflow. That left a gap where deployment could be LIVE_VERIFIED without the incident-specific interaction proof.
prevention: Every website production readback must execute tools/site-shell/verify-pricing-i18n-production.mjs after exact deploy identity is observed.
The browser proof must click lifecycle, plan and billing controls and navigate through the actual language switch to /en/prijzen.
A change to the production readback workflow itself must force one /prijzen browser proof so the new gate proves itself immediately.
LIVE_BEWEZEN requires both exact production SHA and interaction-level browser success.

evidence.gap: generic route proof without pricing/i18n interaction proof
